domain: Cognitive Research and Participant Data Analysis
scenario:
An international research organization is developing a comprehensive cognitive research and participant data management system. The system is designed to facilitate the collection, storage, and analysis of participant data from various studies focused on cognitive capabilities and demographics. The research primarily aims to analyze correlations between age, handedness, and cognitive performance as measured by IQ scores within different study groups.

The system will support multiple research projects, each with unique participant groups, data collection methods, and analytical models. It must provide a robust platform for managing participant demographics, test results, and study metadata. Researchers require detailed analytics and reporting tools to assess cognitive trends, identify patterns, and draw insights from the data. 

The platform should accommodate complex relationships between research projects, participant data, and analysis outcomes. It should also include advanced user management to control access to sensitive participant information, with roles tailored for researchers, data analysts, and project administrators. The system will support collaborative efforts across research teams and provide tools for monitoring data usage and research outcomes.
